1: <!-- dsh-deepseek-webchat（DeepSeek 网页版侧栏插件） · 关键词 · dsh-deepseek-webchat、deepseek-webchat、上下文选择器、picker、勾选、checkbox、seq、重复 key、color-scheme、原生 select 弹层白底白字、行身份 -->
2: 
3: - [2026-10-28] **这个插件的「条目」身份不能是事件 `seq`：一个事件会产出多行**。`extractMessages` 里一条 `assistant/message` 会同时产出 `assistant`（正文）+ `reasoning`（思考）+ 每个 tool-call 一行，全部挂同一个 `event.seq`；`tool/call` 同理。用真实会话实测：默认集 1193 行全唯一，**高级集 8770 行里只有 6729 个不同 seq，2041 行是重复的（23%）**。所以凡是「按 seq 记状态 / 按 seq 当 React key」的地方，在那 23% 的行上就是共享同一份状态 + 重复 key（React 每次渲染会把重复 key 的那个重新挂载）。修法：host 侧在 rows 末尾补一个 `id = seq + ':' + 同 seq 序号`（按日志顺序推导，重读稳定），client 侧的 `selected`、`key`、`data-id` 全改用 `id`。**这个 bug 的症状就是「有的条目怎么点都勾不上 / 取消不掉」，而且只在开了「高级」时才出现。**
4: 
5: - [2026-10-28] **DSH 的深色外壳不声明 `color-scheme`，于是插件里的原生 `<select>` 弹层是白底、而 option 文字继承了外壳的浅色墨 → 下拉列表看着全白，只有 hover 到某一行时靠高亮垫背才看得见数字**。不要用 `option{color:...}` 硬钉（弹层底色可能仍是浏览器默认浅色，越钉越错）；正解是给 select 声明 `color-scheme`，弹层与文字就会同向渲染。主题无法从 `--dsw-*` 变量反推，可靠做法是从控件所在元素向上找第一个 `alpha>0.4` 的 `background-color`、算感知亮度（`0.2126/0.7152/0.0722`）判深/浅，兜底用 `prefers-color-scheme`；picker 打开时量一次就够。
6: 
7: - [2026-10-28] **`<label>` 包 `<input>` 在 Chromium 里不会双触发**：点 label 文字 → 原生只派发一次 input 的 click（实测 i1clicks=1 / change=1，label 的 click 计数是 2 因为转发的那次也冒泡回来）。所以「点不上」别再往 label 转发上赖；真凶是身份撞车。**顺带一条：行做控件时加 `user-select:none`**，否则鼠标稍微一带就变成选文字，那一击就白点了。

(End of file - total 7 lines)
</content>

1: # dsh-deepseek-webchat
2: 
3: A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) sidebar plugin that shows the **real
4: [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com/) web app** next to your session,
5: binds one DeepSeek conversation to each DSH Session, and lets you push selected
6: messages into the DeepSeek composer as a blockquote — which you then send
7: yourself.
8: 
9: No API key, no proxy, no scraping. It embeds the actual website through the
10: desktop shell's native browser guest, the same channel DSH's built-in side-card
11: browser uses.
12: 
13: - [What it does](#what-it-does)
14: - [Install](#install)
15: - [Using it](#using-it)
16: - [Privacy](#privacy)
17: - [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
18: - [How it works](#how-it-works)
19: - [Development](#development)
20: - [Publishing](#publishing)
21: 
22: ## What it does
23: 
24: | | |
25: |---|---|
26: | **Real web app** | `chat.deepseek.com` itself, in a sidebar tab. Not an iframe, not the API. |
27: | **Login persists** | Sign in once; the plugin restores your session on later launches. |
28: | **One conversation per DSH Session** | Each DSH Session gets its own DeepSeek conversation, remembered by id. |
29: | **Follows the session you switch to** | Switch DSH Sessions and the sidebar follows to that Session's conversation. |
30: | **Manual context push** | Tick rows, add a question, preview it, then fill and send. |
31: | **Questions included** | The agent's questions to you, their options, and your answers are quotable too. |
32: | **Todo list included** | The agent's todo list is quotable without turning anything on. |
33: | **One click to fill** | 「仅填入」 puts the preview in the DeepSeek composer through real input events; you press Enter. |
34: | **Opt-in send** | 「填入后自动发送」 (off by default) presses Enter for you, paced to 20 s / 12 per hour. |
35: | **Bulk selection** | Select all, clear, or take the last 5/10/20/50 rows in one click. |
36: | **Advanced opt-in** | A switch reveals thinking, tool calls and results — off by default. |
37: | **Explained context** | An optional note tells DeepSeek what the quotes are and where they came from. |
38: | **No back-flow** | DeepSeek's answers are never written back into your DSH conversation. |
39: 
40: ## Install
41: 
42: Requires DSH Desktop **0.2.0-rc.1 or newer**, and a profile that is already
43: initialised (the `desktop` profile is created by the app on first run).
44: 
45: ```bash
46: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-deepseek-webchat
47: ```
48: 
49: Then restart DSH Desktop. The tab appears in the sidebar column's guide, and a
50: chat icon in the conversation header opens it directly.
51: 
52: `lib/` is committed to this repository on purpose, and there is no `prepare`
53: script, so the install needs **no build step and no pnpm `allowBuilds`
54: approval**.
55: 
56: <details>
57: <summary>Installing from a local clone instead</summary>
58: 
59: ```bash
60: git clone https://github.com/Ckarefulon/dsh-deepseek-webchat
61: dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-deepseek-webchat
62: ```
63: </details>
64: 
65: <details>
66: <summary>Uninstalling</summary>
67: 
68: ```bash
69: dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-deepseek-webchat
70: ```
71: 
72: Your bindings and saved login live in `~/.dsh/dsh-deepseek-webchat/` and are
73: left in place; delete that directory to remove them too.
74: </details>
75:

78:

80: refuses to open. The crash log (the path is shown in the dialog, under
81: `%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\`) contains
82: `client-modules: client bundle not found`.
83:

Feature 1: "从某处批量选到某处" — click-set endpoints style bulk range selection.

User's idea:
1. Double-click to set an endpoint.
2. Double-click the first box → default from the very bottom (newest) all the way up to here.
3. Double-click the second box → the range between these two endpoints.
4. Double-click the third box → the furthest two boxes apart (i.e., 一 and 三? "选择最远的两个框中间" — the farthest two boxes... hmm)
5. Double-click the fourth box → select between 一、二 and 三、四.
6. And so on.

This is a "nesting" scheme — like binary bracketing. It's clever but honestly confusing. Let me think about what a better design would be.

Let me think about what the user actually wants: range selection in a long list. Standard UI patterns:
- Shift+click to extend from the anchor.
- Drag-select (mouse down on one box, drag to another).
- Click endpoint A, then click endpoint B while holding Shift.

The user's mental model seems to be avoiding modifier keys (maybe because the row is a checkbox toggle — click toggles). The "double-click sets an endpoint" idea is essentially "mark anchors" without modifiers.

But their nesting scheme (1st double-click = bottom to here, 2nd = between the two, 3rd = farthest two apart...) is a sequence of ambiguous outcomes. A user cannot predict what the 3rd double-click does. That's a design smell.

Better alternative: keep "double-click marks an endpoint" but make the semantics uniform and predictable:
- Double-click a row → set/clear that row as the anchor. Show a visible "A" marker.
- Double-click another row with an anchor present → select the whole rest of the list from the newest end down to the nearer endpoint... hmm.

Actually let's think again: what's the most predictable uniform rule?

Option A (recommended): "Shift-click extends range" + keep single click = toggle. This is the universal standard, zero learning. But on a sidebar with row checkboxes, shift-click might conflict... it doesn't; it's a modifier so no conflict.

But the user explicitly wants double-click because presumably they don't want to remember modifiers, or they're using touch? It's a desktop sidebar. Double-click is fine too.

Option B: "Anchor + extension" with double-click:
- Double-click row X → anchor X (and select just X? or nothing?).
- Double-click row Y → select everything between X and Y (inclusive), anchor stays at X? Or moves?

That is deterministic: every double-click after the first selects the range between the anchor and the target. Repeating with the anchor fixed gives "extend/adjust range" which is very natural — like shift-click repeatedly. And "select to the newest" is just: double-click the bottom-most row... no wait, it selects between X and Y, and since the newest is at the bottom, double-clicking the last row selects everything from X to the end. That IS the user's item 2, naturally.

你的规则里有一个我必须指出的问题：**它只能加，不能减。** 第 4 步双击到 3 号框之后，如果手滑多选了，唯一的出路是「清除」从头再来。"第 k 个框"还需要用户在心里数自己点了几次、并且瞄准"最远的两个框中点"这种屏幕上看不见的位置——规则再自洽，也没法在 UI 上自解释。

### 推荐规则（一条核心 + 两个修饰键）

> **选区 = 选框两条边之间的所有行。双击 = 把一条边钉在这一行；只钉了一条边时，另一条边在最底部（最新）。两次双击之间的那一段，就是你要的区间。**

| 手势 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| **双击 X**（第一次） | 选中 `[X … 最新]` —— 你的第 2 条，一模一样 |
| **双击 Y**（之后每次） | 选中 `[X, Y]` 之间，`X` 是**上一次双击的那一行** —— 你的第 3 条，一模一样 |
| **Shift+双击 X** | 把 `[上一个点, X]` **并入**现有选区（你的第 5 条："一、二之间 和 三、四之间"） |
| **Ctrl/⌘+双击 X** | 把 `[上一个点, X]` 从选区里**减去**（批量取消，现有 UI 完全没有的能力） |
| **单击** | 老行为不变：勾一条/取消一条 |
| **Shift+单击** | 传统区间（锚点 = 上一次单击的行），给键盘/老手 |
| **Esc** 或「清除」 | 丢掉端点，退出区间状态 |
| 「选末尾 N」 | 等价于"双击倒数第 N 行"，之后可以接着双击继续调 |

**为什么这个比你的方案好，且结果完全覆盖你要的 5 步：**

### 实现要点（我已经确认过的坑）

1. **`dblclick` 的 `event.target` 是行内部的 `<span>`**，得用 `closest('.dswc-row')` 取 `data-id`。按规范，两次点击落在不同元素上时，`dblclick` 会派发到它们的**最近公共祖先**——但行的 key 稳定、React 只是改 `aria-checked` 不换节点，所以两次都落在同一个 row 上，正常会派发到该 row（这点我会实测，不实测不下结论）。参考 [W3C UI Events 的 click/dblclick 目标规则](https://www.w3.org/TR/2023/WD-uievents-20230509/)。
2. **双击会先发两次 click**，第一次把 X 勾上、第二次又取消，视觉上闪一下。解法：`onClick` 里 `if (e.detail > 1) return`，把快速连击的第二次 click 忽略；`onDoubleClick` 里 `preventDefault()` + 清掉浏览器自动选中的文字（行上已有 `user-select:none`）。
3. **跨页 / 跨「加载更早」**：端点存的是 **完整 rows 下标**（你只挂载了最后 `pageSize` 条），所以区间可以直接覆盖还没加载的老行。这种情况在「已选 N 条」旁边补一句「其中 12 条在更早」。
4. **选区必须按 `id`（`seq:ordinal`），不能按 `seq`**——这是上次踩过的坑（一条 assistant 事件会产出正文+思考+每个工具一行）。现有代码已经是 `id`，新逻辑沿用即可。
5. 切换「高级」/「刷新」会换掉整个 id 集合，端点必须一起丢弃。

轮次的切分点只有一个：**`kind === 'user'` 开始新的一轮**（`answer` ＝ 你的回答，它出现在助手提问之后，**不能**当轮次边界，否则一轮会被劈成两半）。建议 host 侧 `extractMessages` 顺手给每行加一个 `turn` 序号（改动很小、向后兼容），client 就不用重复推导了。

四类勾选的映射（我的建议值，**待你拍板**）：

| 类别 | 包含的 kind | 备注 |
|---|---|---|
| 用户输入 | `user`、`answer`、`command`(role=user) | 你敲下去的一切 |
| 最终输出 | 该轮**最后一条** `assistant` 正文 | 不是全部正文；正在进行中的最后一轮为空 |

顶部那个下拉不能用原生 `<select multiple>`（弹层白底白字的老问题，`color-scheme` 只能救单选的 `<select>`）。做成**自定义气泡弹层 + 复选框列表 + 三档预设**：

设置存 `localStorage`，作为**每一轮的初始值**；改完之后给一个「应用到全部轮次」按钮（否则改了设置只有新展开的轮次会变，看起来像没生效）。

The research confirms:
1. DOM spec: click/dblclick fire on nearest common inclusive ancestor when targets differ — so double-clicking different rows lights up the whole list container (and browsers fire a single click on each element too... Actually with different targets, each click fires on its own target, and dblclick on the common ancestor).
2. Range-select convention (Gmail/Sheets/Finder): anchor + shift-click, anchor moves only on unmodified click, checkbox is visual reflection, `aria-checked="mixed"` for the header checkbox. Also: selection persists across paging; a range never spans pages in virtualized grids — but in our case we do have the full ordered list in memory (only the last pageSize are mounted), so we CAN resolve ranges over the whole data, which is better. That's a nice differentiator: our list is only *rendered* windowed; the data is complete, so "first/last in range" over the whole session works.

The "same visual position → select to end" idea of the user's is essentially the "far point" convention (as in Excel: click a cell, scroll, shift-click another cell). With a full data model, "select to end" is expressible as "range from N to the last row". So the user's insight reduces to: "double-click on row N, when the current range already starts at N or ends at N, extends to the far end of the list" — i.e., a second double-click at an endpoint toggles the endpoint between "bounded" and "unbounded (to end)".

1: /**
2:  * dsh-deepseek-webchat — browser half.
3:  *
4:  * A sidebar tab that shows the **real** chat.deepseek.com web app and lets you
5:  * push selected DSH messages into it by hand.
6:  *
7:  * ## Why this is not an iframe
8:  *
9:  * `chat.deepseek.com` answers with `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors
10:  * 'none'`, so an `<iframe>` is refused by the page itself. The only supported
11:  * way in is the desktop shell's own browser guest channel: this bundle asks
12:  * `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser.acquire(workspace)` for a reservation, then
13:  * attaches a `<webview>` whose `src` is `about:blank#<lease>` and whose
14:  * `partition` is the one the shell issued. The shell's `will-attach-webview`
15:  * matches the lease, rewrites the element with hardened web preferences and
16:  * lets the navigation through. That is the same channel the built-in side-card
17:  * browser uses, so `frame-ancestors` never enters into it.
18:  *
19:  * ## Why the guest lives outside React
20:  *
21:  * A `<webview>` is destroyed when it leaves the document. If the slot owned it,
22:  * every look at another tab would tear down the page and reload it — losing a
23:  * half-typed question and re-running the site's boot. So the element lives in a
24:  * container this plugin owns at the document root, and the slot's body only
25:  * *measures* its area: the persistent guest is positioned onto that rectangle
26:  * while this tab is showing, and hidden when it is not. The tab type declares
27:  * `keepMounted: true` so the body itself survives tab switches and can keep
28:  * reporting that rectangle.
29:  *
30:  * ## One DeepSeek conversation per DSH Session
31:  *
32:  * DeepSeek's own routes (read from its shipped bundle) are
33:  * `/a/:agentId/s/:sessionId`, so a conversation is addressable as a plain URL.
34:  * The mapping DSH Session → DeepSeek conversation id is learned by watching the
35:  * guest's URL (the id only appears once the first message is sent, because
36:  * DeepSeek creates conversations lazily) and is persisted by the host half,
37:  * which is where a durable file can live.
38:  *
39:  * ## What this half never does
40:  *
41:  * It never sends anything to DeepSeek on its own. Selecting messages composes a
42:  * blockquote and *fills the composer*; pressing Enter is the human's move. It
43:  * never reads a DeepSeek answer back into the DSH conversation, and it never
44:  * quotes system, developer or injected-prompt events — those are filtered by the
45:  * host half before they reach the picker.
46:  */

## 批量选择：按你最终要求，不做双击

```
单击        → 勾一条 / 取消一条，并把锚点设在这里
Shift+单击  → 从锚点画区间（重画，不是追加）
Ctrl+单击   → 只切换这一条
Ctrl+Shift  → 把「焦点 → 这一条」这段区间并进当前选区
```

关键实现细节：`anchor` / `focus` / `base` 三个值放在一个 **ref** 里，不放在 state 里，因为同一次操作里第二次点击必须读到第一次刚写的值，而 state 要等下一次渲染才生效。`base` 是「这一串修饰键点击开始之前的选区」：只靠它，Shift+单击才能**重画**区间；即使第一次点击超出了目标，只要再点一次靠近锚点的地方，就能把区间收回来。Ctrl+Shift 单击则是把另一段区间加到 `base` 上，所以「一、二之间」和「三、四之间」这种并集才是可能的。

区间在**整个 `messages` 数组**上解析，而不是只在已挂载的那几屏里解析。否则点「全选」之后再 Shift 扩展，屏幕外的已勾选项会无故消失。

键盘也走同一套逻辑：空格是单击，Shift+空格是区间。

## 轮次视图

轮次边界只有一处：**`kind === 'user'`**。你回答助手提问（`answer`）时**不算**新的一轮；否则一次问答会被切成两部分。`turn` 序号在 host 的 `extractMessages` 里计算好，因为 `boundRows` 是拷贝行，而不是重新编号，所以即使行被尺寸上限截掉，它仍然保持自己的轮次。

每一轮有四类复选，但**不单独保存状态**，而是展开成 row id 加入同一个 `selected` 集合：

| | 包含 | 是否含在「标准」 |
|---|---|---|
| 用户输入 | `user`、`answer` | ✓ |
| 最终输出 | 该轮**最后一条**助手正文 | ✓ |
| 过程对话 | 该轮**其余**助手正文 + `question` + `todo` | ✓ |
| 详细内容 | `reasoning`/`tool-call`/`tool-result`/`command`/`summary` | ✗ |

所以两个视图操作的是**同一份选区**，切换视图不会丢失，计数也永远一致。某一轮的复选框状态全部从 `selected` 反推：全选时勾选，部分选中时显示 `mixed` 横杠。

「最终输出」和「过程对话」的切分是**按位置**，不是按 kind：助手正文的 kind 是 `assistant`，它天然属于 `process`，但最后一条要归 `final`。

**默认选择**：默认设置就是唯一来源。没有单独改过的那一轮直接读取默认值，改过的那一轮才写入 `overrides`。因此「默认从标准改成最小」时，所有没改过的这一轮**立刻跟着变**，改过的那一轮保持原样；这正是你说的「相同变、不同不动」，所以不需要「应用到全部」。

108: ## Using it
109: 
110: 1. **Open the tab.** Click the chat icon in the conversation header, or pick
111:    「DeepSeek 网页版」 from the sidebar column's guide.
112: 2. **Sign in** to DeepSeek the first time. It is a normal browser login, inside
113:    the panel.
114: 3. **Send one message** in the DeepSeek page. DeepSeek creates a conversation
115:    lazily, so this is the moment its id exists — the plugin notices and binds it
116:    to the current DSH Session. The toolbar dot turns green.
117: 4. **Quote context.** Press 「引用上下文」. The list opens scrolled to the newest
118:    rows. Tick what you want — or use 「全选」, 「清除」, or the number box plus
119:    「选末尾」 to take the last few in one go — optionally type a question or
120:    instruction, and check the preview. The list holds your turns, the assistant's
121:    replies, **the agent's todo list**, **the questions it asked you** (with the
122:    options it offered), and **your answers** to them.
123: 5. **Press 「仅填入」.** The text lands in DeepSeek's composer through the
124:    browser's own input channel, the panel returns to the page, and the selection
125:    clears. Read it there and press Enter yourself — that is the normal path, and
126:    the one this plugin is built around.
127:    If you would rather it submitted for you, tick 「填入后自动发送」 first; the
128:    plugin then presses Enter after a short pause, no more than once every 20
129:    seconds and twelve times an hour.
130: 6. **The plugin checks its work.** After an automatic send it reads the composer
131:    back to confirm the message went out, and says so — or tells you plainly that
132:    it did not, so you can press Enter there yourself.
133: 
134: The toolbar also has 「刷新」 (reload the page) and 「解除绑定」 (forget this
135: Session's conversation, so the next visit starts a new one).
136: 
137: Switching to a different DSH Session moves the panel to *that* Session's
138: conversation automatically.
139: 
140: ### What gets sent, and how
141: 
142: Every push is still something you asked for: nothing is sent on a timer, nothing
143: is uploaded in the background, and nothing is sent merely because the panel is
144: open.
145: 
146: **Filling is the default; sending is opt-in.** 「仅填入」 puts the text in
147: DeepSeek's composer and stops there, so you read it and press Enter yourself.
148: Automatic submitting only exists behind **「填入后自动发送」**, which is off on
149: every launch — filling a composer is a text edit, while submitting is a message
150: your account sends, and only the second one is automation.

## 合并进仓库时补做的事

这个仓库自带的 114 项测试是**对 bundle 文本的结构性断言**，其中有几条正好断言了我上一轮删掉的设计。合并后 9 项失败，分三类：

**①② 断言描述的是旧设计，改的是测试。** `autoSend` 勾选框、`toggle(row.id)` 裸调用、按 `color-scheme` 给原生弹层上色——这些在你的要求里被替换掉了，所以断言跟着换成新契约（两个按钮、`onRowClick(event, row.id, index)`、自绘气泡），并**新增了 5 条**覆盖轮次视图、Shift/Ctrl 区间、单一选区共享、按需拉取 detail。

**③ host 侧的 `deepEqual` 多了 `turn` 字段，改的是测试但顺手把实现收紧了。** 我原本让第一轮人类消息之前的行（开场白、压缩摘要）落在 `turn: 0`。那是个坏设计：轮次视图没法区分“不属于任何一轮”和“第一轮”，只能把它渲染成一个假的第一轮。改成 `null` 之后语义干净了，也让测试里那句 `deepEqual` 的期望更诚实。

**④ 渲染测试在 CI 里没有 React。** CI 只跑 `npm test`，`package.json` 里没有任何依赖。我加了 `npm run check:render`：按需把 `react`/`react-dom`/`js-yaml` 装进一个被 git 忽略的 `.tools/`（三样必须**一次装完**，因为 `--no-save` 的第二次安装会把第一次的剪掉——这个坑我自己踩了一次），然后跑全量。缺 React 时那 3 项 `skip` 而不是 `fail`：

- 有 React：**132 pass / 0 fail / 0 skip**
- 无 React（CI 的形状）：**129 pass / 0 fail / 3 skip**

顺带说一句：这个渲染测试在上一轮当场抓到了 `Cannot access 'total' before initialization`——单行函数体里 `const` 前置引用是**抛错**而不是 `undefined`。这类 bug 编译通过、审阅看不出，第一次渲染才炸。所以它值得留在仓库里，而且值得在发版前跑一次。
